features.name: WCAG 2.1 Level AA Compliance
features.description: Comply with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1 Level AA standards for accessibility

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user of the car rental platform, I want an intuitive, accessible interface that works seamlessly on any device, so that I can complete my tasks efficiently regardless of my abilities or device choice.
acceptanceCriteria: All images have descriptive alt text
Color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text)
All functionality is keyboard accessible
Focus indicators are visible and clear
ARIA labels are used appropriately for screen readers

features.name: Screen Reader Compatibility
features.description: Ensure full compatibility with screen readers including JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver

requirementDetails.userStory: As a blind or visually impaired user, I want screen reader compatibility to use the platform effectively.
acceptanceCriteria: Semantic HTML is used throughout
ARIA landmarks identify page regions
Form labels are properly associated with inputs
Dynamic content updates are announced
Screen reader testing is performed regularly

features.name: Complete Keyboard Navigation
features.description: Support complete keyboard navigation without requiring a mouse

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user with motor disabilities or keyboard preference, I want full keyboard navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab order follows logical reading order
All interactive elements are keyboard accessible
Keyboard shortcuts are documented and consistent
Focus traps are avoided or properly managed
Skip navigation links are provided

features.name: Accessible Mobility Features with Hard Allocation
features.description: Provide guaranteed specific vehicle allocation for accessible vehicles with VIN-locked bookings

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user requiring accessible vehicles, I need guaranteed access to specific vehicles with required modifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Filters for hand controls, wheelchair ramps, and other accessibility equipment
VIN-locked bookings guarantee specific accessible vehicles
Hard allocation logic prevents vehicle swapping
Accessible vehicle availability is clearly indicated
Booking confirmations specify exact vehicle with accessibility features

features.name: Text Sizing and Zoom Support
features.description: Support text resizing and browser zoom up to 200% without breaking layout or functionality

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user with visual impairments, I want to resize text for better readability.
acceptanceCriteria: Text can be resized up to 200% without loss of functionality
Browser zoom up to 200% maintains usability
Responsive design adapts to different viewport sizes
No horizontal scrolling at standard zoom levels
Text remains readable at all supported sizes

features.name: Mobile-Responsive Design
features.description: Provide fully responsive design that adapts to all device sizes from smartphones to large desktop monitors

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user on any device, I want the interface to adapt seamlessly to my screen size.
acceptanceCriteria: Layout adapts seamlessly to viewport sizes from 320px to 2560px width
Touch targets are at least 44x44 pixels on mobile
Text is readable without zooming on mobile devices
Navigation is optimized for mobile (hamburger menu, bottom navigation)
Forms are mobile-optimized with appropriate input types

features.name: Touch-Friendly Interactions
features.description: Provide touch-optimized interactions with adequate touch targets and spacing

requirementDetails.userStory: As a mobile user, I want touch-friendly interactions to prevent mis-taps.
acceptanceCriteria: Buttons and links have minimum 44x44 pixel touch targets
Adequate spacing between interactive elements (minimum 8px)
Swipe gestures are supported where appropriate
Long-press actions are avoided or have alternatives
Touch feedback is immediate and clear

features.name: Mobile-Optimized Forms
features.description: Optimize form inputs for mobile interaction with appropriate input types and autocomplete

requirementDetails.userStory: As a mobile user, I want optimized forms to reduce typing burden.
acceptanceCriteria: Input types match expected data (tel, email, date, number)
Autocomplete attributes enable browser auto-fill
Form fields are large enough for easy tapping
Validation messages appear near relevant fields
Multi-step forms show progress and allow navigation

features.name: PWA Offline Capability
features.description: Provide offline functionality for critical features through Progressive Web App capabilities

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user without network connectivity, I want access to critical information offline.
acceptanceCriteria: Service worker caches critical resources
Users can view booking details offline
Digital keys work offline via Bluetooth
Offline actions queue for sync when online
Clear indicators show online/offline status

features.name: PWA Installation Support
features.description: Support Progressive Web App installation on mobile and desktop devices

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want to install the app for app-like experience without app store downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Web app manifest is properly configured
Service worker is registered and functional
Install prompts appear at appropriate times
Installed app launches in standalone mode
App icon and splash screen are configured

features.name: Native Hardware Access via PWA
features.description: Access native device hardware (camera, GPS, BLE, biometrics) through PWA capabilities

requirementDetails.userStory: As a PWA user, I want access to device hardware for advanced features.
acceptanceCriteria: Camera access for document scanning and AR features
GPS access for location-based services
Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for keyless vehicle entry
Push notifications for booking updates
Biometric authentication (Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint)

features.name: App-Like PWA Experience
features.description: Provide app-like user experience through PWA capabilities with smooth animations and native patterns

requirementDetails.userStory: As a PWA user, I want app-like experience with familiar interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Fast loading with cached resources
Smooth animations and transitions
No browser chrome in standalone mode
Native-like navigation patterns
Consistent experience across platforms

features.name: Intuitive Navigation
features.description: Provide intuitive navigation that enables users to find features and information easily

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want intuitive navigation to find features easily.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation structure is logical and consistent
Current location is clearly indicated
Breadcrumbs show navigation path on complex pages
Search functionality helps users find content
Important actions are prominently placed

features.name: Consistent Design Language
features.description: Maintain consistent visual design and interaction patterns throughout the platform

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want consistent design to build confidence through predictable interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Design system defines colors, typography, spacing
UI components are reusable and consistent
Interaction patterns are predictable
Terminology is consistent across the platform
Visual hierarchy guides user attention

features.name: Clear Visual Feedback
features.description: Provide immediate, clear visual feedback for all user interactions

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want immediate feedback to know my actions are registered.
acceptanceCriteria: Button states (hover, active, disabled) are visually distinct
Loading indicators appear for operations taking > 1 second
Success and error messages are clear and actionable
Form validation provides immediate feedback
Progress indicators show completion status

features.name: Error Prevention and Recovery
features.description: Prevent errors where possible and provide clear recovery paths when errors occur

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want error prevention and clear recovery to complete tasks successfully.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirmation dialogs prevent accidental destructive actions
Input validation prevents invalid data entry
Error messages explain what went wrong and how to fix it
Users can undo or cancel actions where appropriate
Form data is preserved when errors occur

features.name: Preference Management
features.description: Remember and apply user preferences across sessions

requirementDetails.userStory: As a returning user, I want my preferences saved to speed up booking.
acceptanceCriteria: Preferred pickup locations are saved
Favorite vehicle types are remembered
Insurance preferences are pre-selected
Payment methods are saved securely
Communication preferences are respected

features.name: Augmented Reality Features
features.description: Provide immersive vehicle discovery experiences through AR capabilities

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want AR features to explore vehicles immersively.
acceptanceCriteria: AR showrooms project 3D vehicle models
360-degree interior views available
AR wayfinding guides users to vehicles in parking facilities
AR features work on standard mobile devices
Fallback to traditional images when AR unavailable

features.name: Multi-Language Support
features.description: Support multiple languages to serve diverse user populations

requirementDetails.userStory: As a non-English speaker, I want the interface in my language.
acceptanceCriteria: Interface text is externalized for translation
Users can select preferred language
Language preference persists across sessions
Date, time, and number formats adapt to locale
Right-to-left (RTL) languages are supported

features.name: Currency and Regional Adaptation
features.description: Adapt to regional conventions for currency, measurements, and business practices

requirementDetails.userStory: As an international user, I want regional conventions for familiar experience.
acceptanceCriteria: Prices display in user's local currency
Measurements use local units (miles vs kilometers)
Regional payment methods are supported
Regional regulations are reflected in policies
Regional holidays and events affect availability

features.name: Perceived Performance Optimization
features.description: Optimize perceived performance through progressive loading and optimistic UI updates

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want the system to feel fast through progressive loading.
acceptanceCriteria: Critical content loads first (above-the-fold)
Skeleton screens show during loading
Optimistic UI updates provide immediate feedback
Progressive image loading (blur-up technique)
Lazy loading for below-the-fold content

features.name: Minimal Cognitive Load
features.description: Minimize cognitive load through progressive disclosure and clear information hierarchy

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want simple interfaces that don't overwhelm me.
acceptanceCriteria: Complex features are broken into simple steps
Advanced options are hidden until needed
Information is presented in logical chunks
Visual hierarchy guides attention to important elements
Help and documentation are contextual

features.name: Usability Testing
features.description: Conduct regular usability testing with representative users

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want usability testing to identify issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Usability testing occurs before major releases
Test participants represent target user segments
Task completion rates are measured
User satisfaction is assessed
Findings drive interface improvements

features.name: Usability Analytics and Metrics
features.description: Track usability metrics to identify improvement opportunities

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want usability metrics for data-driven optimization.
acceptanceCriteria: Task completion rates are tracked
Time to complete key tasks is measured
Error rates and abandonment points are identified
User satisfaction scores (NPS, CSAT) are collected
Metrics inform continuous improvement
